papers.abstract: When a robot is damaged, it must decide which routes it can still afford, and the amount of risk it may accept can change from one mission to the next. We argue that whether a learned model helps such a robot depends on its decision interface, that is, on what the model hands to the planner. A decision policy tells the planner what to do, whereas an outcome model, a kind of world model, predicts the consequences of each route. We study simulated Unitree Go2 quadrupeds and H1 humanoids with weakened motors, added payloads, or reduced foot friction. We compare four interfaces. The first is a decision policy, and the second is the same policy trained with fixed penalties for infeasible routes. The third is an outcome model that predicts the feasibility and travel time of each route. The fourth, which we call a capability contract, is an outcome model that predicts the chance of success and the travel time of the robot on each terrain and composes them along a route. All share the same collected experience, matched tuning and risk calibration, and an uncertainty guard. Two comparatively low-risk probes let the capability contract rank hazardous terrains about as well as four new trials on every hazard. At a calibrated 5% limit on selecting empirically infeasible routes, outcome models cut declined missions from about 32% to 7-8% on Go2 and from 57% to 35-36% on H1 compared with the plain policy. Fixed penalties narrow this gap, but the best penalty changes with the risk target. Predicting outcomes lets the planner preserve missions by changing routes as risk requirements tighten.

analysis.key_results: 在5%不可行路线选择率限制下，结果模型使 Go2 的拒绝任务从约32%降至7-8%，H1 从57%降至35-36%；能力契约仅需两个低风险探测即可达到与每个危险地形四次新试验相当的排序效果。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并比较了四种模型决策接口（普通决策策略、固定惩罚策略、结果模型、能力契约），证明结果模型（尤其是能力契约）能在校准风险限制下显著减少拒绝任务的比例。
analysis.method: 在模拟的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人和 H1 人形机器人上，通过改变电机力量、增加负载或降低足部摩擦模拟损伤，训练并对比四种接口的表现。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究在机器人受损后风险感知规划中，学习模型应提供的决策接口（决策策略 vs. 结果模型/能力契约）对任务成功率与风险校准的影响。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文的结果模型属于世界模型（World Model）范畴，预测机器人在地形上的成功概率和旅行时间，并沿路线组合，与本站关注的世界建模主题直接相关；虽然未涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，但为机器人世界模型在风险感知规划中的应用提供了实证支持。

papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding but remain limited in their ability to reason about metric 3D space in the physical world. Existing VLMs typically infer 3D scene structure from one or more images without known camera calibration or cross-view geometric constraints. This makes metric 3D inference inherently ambiguous and leaves it unclear whether their spatial predictions are grounded in visual evidence or driven primarily by semantic priors. In contrast, calibrated stereo provides explicit cross-view geometry that resolves this ambiguity and offers a more reliable foundation for metric 3D perception and geometric generalization. We investigate how VLMs can learn transferable 3D representations directly from calibrated binocular observations. To this end, we introduce StereoVLM, the first geometry-aware binocular VLM for metric 3D spatial reasoning. StereoVLM follows a hierarchical learning paradigm spanning from cross-view correspondence and disparity estimation to calibration-conditioned metric depth perception and semantic spatial reasoning. We further find that disparity supervision generalizes substantially better than direct binocular depth supervision on unseen environments. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Stereo3D-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark across three levels, from point-level geometry to object-level spatial reasoning. StereoVLM-8B achieves 95.17% depth accuracy ($\delta_1$) and a 66.98 average object-level score on Stereo3D-Bench. Intervention results further indicate that the model's performance on Stereo3D-Bench benefits from valid cross-view geometry and cannot be explained solely by additional visual tokens or semantic priors. Hierarchical geometric supervision also yields average gains of 3.54 points across five spatial benchmarks and 4.3 percentage points in RoboCasa manipulation success.

analysis.key_results: StereoVLM-8B在Stereo3D-Bench上达到95.17%的深度准确率（δ1）和66.98的平均对象级得分；层次几何监督在五个空间基准上平均提升3.54分，在RoboCasa操作成功率上提升4.3个百分点。

analysis.method: 采用层次化学习范式，从跨视角对应和视差估计到校准条件下的度量深度感知和语义空间推理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出StereoVLM，一个利用双目校准图像学习可迁移度量三维表示的视觉语言模型，并构建Stereo3D-Bench基准验证其空间推理能力。

papers.abstract: Streaming visual geometry transformers retain historical key-value (KV) states as cross-view geometric memory, but growing caches constrain long-sequence inference. We systematically characterize KV quantization in streaming geometry and uncover two linked challenges: Nonuniform Geometric Sensitivity and Cache-Geometry Mismatch. Quantization sensitivity varies across precision choices and cache locations, while perturbed retrieval changes geometry-head inputs and propagates through subsequent predictions and KV writes. Guided by these findings, we propose QuantStream3D, to our knowledge the first dedicated KV quantization framework for streaming visual geometry transformers. Geometry-Guided Mixed-Precision KV Quantization protects sensitive cross-view evidence, while Geometry-Aligned Quantization-Aware Distillation jointly adapts transformer blocks and geometry heads on student-generated quantized history. Across five benchmarks and two backbones, QuantStream3D achieves near-lossless geometric accuracy in most settings with predominantly 2-bit KV caches, and many configurations surpass unquantized inference. Compared with LLM-oriented KV quantizers, it reduces TUM absolute trajectory error and NeuralRGBD completeness error by up to 57.4% and 69.7%, respectively. Integration with existing native cache-pruning methods further pushes compression while improving reconstruction quality on NeuralRGBD. Our optimized StreamVGGT backend achieves $5.05\times$ physical KV compression and 23.1% lower latency at batch size one. Under a fixed memory budget on the same GPU, it supports $5.4\times$ the maximum batch size and up to $1.67\times$ the peak throughput of unquantized inference. Code and pretrained checkpoints will be made publicly available.

analysis.key_results: 在五个基准和两种主干上，2位KV缓存实现近无损几何精度；在TUM绝对轨迹误差上降低57.4%，在NeuralRGBD完整性误差上降低69.7%；后端实现5.05倍物理压缩、23.1%延迟降低，支持最大批量大小5.4倍、峰值吞吐量1.67倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出QuantStream3D，首个面向流式视觉几何Transformer的专用KV缓存量化框架，包含几何引导混合精度量化与几何对齐量化感知蒸馏，实现近无损几何精度。
analysis.method: 几何引导混合精度KV量化：根据几何敏感性分配精度；几何对齐量化感知蒸馏：用学生生成的量化历史联合适配Transformer块和几何头。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出首个针对流式视觉几何Transformer的KV缓存量化框架QuantStream3D，通过几何引导的混合精度量化和几何对齐的量化感知蒸馏实现近无损压缩。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model inference by preparing candidate continuations before the target model generates them. Its efficiency depends on how well limited drafting computation anticipates the path the target will actually follow. Anticipating this path involves two sources of uncertainty: the target model's predictions and the randomness of sampling. Yet the former requires a target-model forward pass, while the latter can be fixed before drafting. Building on this observation, we introduce DICE (Draw-Informed Candidate Selection), which pre-samples and synchronizes verification randomness across drafting and verification. By combining these known draws with predictions from an existing drafter, DICE allocates computation toward continuations more likely to be used in the current sampling run. This principle guides node selection throughout draft-tree construction and extends to asynchronous prefetching, where DICE predicts which next-round drafts to prepare. Without additional drafter training or changes to the target sampling distribution, DICE achieves state-of-the-art decoding throughput across diverse settings, with speedups of up to 24.6pp over strong baselines.

analysis.key_results: 在多种设置下实现了最先进的解码吞吐量，相比强基线最高提升24.6个百分点（pp）。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入DICE（Draw-Informed Candidate Selection），通过预采样验证随机性并将其与草稿模型预测结合，改进草稿树节点选择与异步预取，在不改变目标采样分布或额外训练草稿模型的情况下提升推测解码吞吐量。
analysis.method: DICE，即“Draw-Informed Candidate Selection”，在草稿生成前预先采样验证随机性，并在草稿和验证阶段同步这些随机数；利用已知采样结果与草稿模型预测共同指导草稿树构建和异步预取中的节点选择。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出DICE方法，通过预采样并同步验证阶段的随机性来减少推测解码中的不确定性，从而提升解码吞吐量。

papers.abstract: Linear manufacturing typically operates in highly structured settings with standardized objects, allowing robots to execute pre-programmed motions based on precise models. In contrast, circular manufacturing involves dynamic and less controlled environments, where product components can vary due to appearance and physical changes across different product generations. In this context, uncertainty arises from both the unknown or partially observed states of components (e.g., damaged surfaces, altered shapes) and the unstructured disassembly environment, often characterized by heavy clutter, occlusions, and limited sensing viewpoints. This demands a flexible and adaptable robotic grasping system that can cope with unexpected object changes. To address these challenges, this paper proposes an autonomous grasp learning framework designed for highly uncertain and variable conditions. The framework explicitly distinguishes between uncertainty due to noisy or incomplete sensory observations (aleatoric uncertainty) and uncertainty due to limited knowledge and distribution shift (epistemic uncertainty). Moreover, the framework employs an active perception strategy to reduce visual ambiguity: semantic and spatial scene understanding is achieved using vision language models (VLMs), while view planning enables the robot to adjust its viewpoint to improve observability. In addition, the approach leverages large-scale human demonstration data to learn interaction patterns, which are then transferred to robotic end-effectors, enabling robust manipulation in these variable settings. Quantitative validation, including the utility of active vision on disassembled components in practice, is expected to form an important part of future work.

papers.abstract: Multimodal search agents answer knowledge intensive visual questions by grounding them in retrieved evidence, and recent recipes train them on multi hop tasks that are synthesized from knowledge graphs and grown online to keep pace with the agent. These recipes, however, treat the searchable world as fixed: a new question can be well formed and verifiable while its evidence is absent from the retrieval backend, so the agent issues the right query, retrieves nothing, and is penalized as if its policy were at fault. Such unreachable negatives accumulate with every round of growth. We propose Search-RSI, a recursive self improvement framework that expands the search world along the agent's capability frontier. In each round, the current policy diagnoses its partially mastered regions of a task space spanned by hop depth, relation rarity, and distractor density; new tasks there are grown together with their evidence; and the same policy decides how they are used: candidates on which its probes disagree feed reinforcement learning, while those beyond its reach become hint guided demonstrations of its own. Keeping the policy inside this loop matters: an improver frozen at the start of training loses 3.2 points. On nine multimodal search benchmarks, Search-RSI keeps improving where static task growth saturates, raising the average accuracy of the recipe it builds on by 9.8 and 9.5 points at 9B and 27B, of which 7.0 points are out of reach for a world that is merely made consistent. The loop uses no external model and only privileged task structure that is removed before training, at 1.27x the compute of static growth.

analysis.key_results: 在九个多模态搜索基准上，Search-RSI平均准确率在9B和27B模型上分别提高9.8和9.5个百分点，其中7.0个百分点是仅使世界一致无法达到的；训练起始时冻结的改进器性能下降3.2个百分点；计算成本为静态增长的1.27倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Search-RSI框架，通过递归自我改进动态扩展搜索世界，使任务生成与证据检索同步，从而提升多模态搜索智能体的训练效果。
analysis.method: 每轮训练中，当前策略诊断任务空间中部分掌握的区域（跳跃深度、关系稀有度、干扰密度），在该区域生成任务及其证据，并根据策略的一致性决定用于强化学习或提示引导的自我演示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出Search-RSI递归自我改进框架，在多模态搜索智能体的能力前沿扩展搜索世界，以解决静态任务增长中不可达负样本累积的问题。

papers.abstract: Training a humanoid motion tracker by backpropagating imagined returns through a learned world model is fast, because the model gives a first-order policy gradient. We ask how much of that gradient holds in the simulator. On a tracker for the Unitree G1, the $0.5\%$ of imagined rollouts with the largest gradients carry $22\%$ of the summed gradient norm, yet neither a second rollout from the same state nor the simulator confirms them. When the actions are moved along the model's gradient, the simulator returns 94% of the predicted change in return where the gradient norm is below the batch median, 48% between 3 and 10 times the median, and 1% above 30 times; the part of a gradient that either check confirms stops growing at a few times the median. We therefore cap each rollout's action-gradient norm at 10 times the batch median, draw imagination starts in proportion to their predicted gradient norm so that the cap removes less, and reset episodes where the world model and critic predict the lowest return. Trained on 223 hours of motion and tested on 353 motions that no actor performed in training, the method raises the normalized return of SuperMimic, the baseline it builds on, from 0.953 to 0.967 and the lowest $1\%$ of test clips from 0.65 to 0.76, halves the test clips that fall persistently, from 15--18 to 7--10, and reaches the baseline's final return in 40% of the baseline's iterations and half its training time. On LAFAN1, trained and evaluated on the same clips as prior work, it reaches 0.935 against 0.906.

analysis.key_results: 在223小时运动数据训练、353个未见过动作测试中，将SuperMimic的归一化回报从0.953提升至0.967，最低1%测试片段从0.65提升至0.76，持续跌倒片段减少一半，训练时间减半；在LAFAN1上达到0.935（对比0.906）。

papers.abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can improve pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies through imagined experiences. However, existing VLA-MBRL methods primarily rely on large-scale image or video generation world models, incurring large computational overhead. Latent world models offer a more efficient alternative but face two challenges: compounding errors during recursive prediction and incompatibility with VLAs' visual input interfaces. In this work, we propose LS-MBPO, a lightweight residual MBRL framework that leverages latent world models to improve upon pretrained VLAs. LS-MBPO introduces two key techniques: (1) Hierarchical Forcing, which combines dense causal supervision with autoregressive feedback to mitigate compounding prediction errors; and (2) Latent Subchunk Rollouts, which leverage action chunks from a frozen VLA policy and a latent residual policy for successive subchunk refinement, bridging the gap between latent imagination and VLA policy execution. We further introduce a Progress-Conditioned Branch-Start Curriculum that progressively shifts rollout starting points from later to earlier task stages, enabling effective policy learning from short imagined rollouts. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world ALOHA robot show that LS-MBPO achieves superior task performance and training efficiency compared to existing methods.

analysis.key_results: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 和真实 ALOHA 机器人上，LS-MBPO 相比于现有方法取得了更优的任务性能和训练效率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 LS-MBPO 框架，利用潜世界模型实现高效的基于模型的 VLA 策略改进，引入 Hierarchical Forcing、Latent Subchunk Rollouts 和 Progress-Conditioned Branch-Start Curriculum 三项关键技术。

papers.abstract: Latent world models plan by rolling out hundreds of candidate action sequences through a transformer predictor, so a single decision can take tens of seconds. Existing accelerations prune spatial tokens as in vision-language models, yet a sampling-based planner uses predicted costs only to rank candidates, so a rollout can be compressed freely as long as the ranking survives. We propose SOAR, a training-free method that adapts rollout compression to each planning decision. At every decision, SOAR probes a few candidates under several token budgets and keeps the smallest budget that preserves their ranking, so it compresses as far as the current decision allows, without task labels. A closed-loop study of more than 80,000 episodes fixes the rest of the rollout: the first step, which alone reads a real observation, stays exact, and the context frame is cached rather than recomputed. On seven navigation and manipulation tasks with frozen checkpoints, SOAR matches dense-level planning success at 2.3x speedup and retains 98% at 2.5x. Our code is available at https://github.com/starrywiki/SOAR.

analysis.key_results: 在七个导航和操作任务中，SOAR在冻结模型上匹配稠密级规划成功率并实现2.3倍加速，在2.5倍加速下保持98%成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SOAR，一种无需训练、秩一致的自适应展开压缩技术，通过在每个规划决策处探测不同令牌预算并保留候选动作排名，加速潜世界模型的采样规划。
analysis.method: 在每个规划决策处，SOAR对若干候选动作序列在多个令牌预算下进行采样，选择保持候选排名的最小预算，并对第一步观测保持精确、缓存上下文帧以重用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SOAR提出一种无需训练的自适应展开压缩方法，在潜世界模型采样规划中按决策动态选择最小令牌预算，实现2.3-2.5倍加速且保持成功率。

papers.abstract: Serving engines treat the ways of running a greedy language model as interchangeable: cached or not, padded or not, alone or batched, one token or several verified at once (speculative decoding). In finite precision they round differently. We measure how often the greedy text of Qwen3-0.6B (bfloat16, 128 new tokens, GSM8K and ARC prompts) differs from a reference that decodes one token per pass. Verifying 4 guessed tokens per pass changes 60% of 150 prompts and padding changes 68%; every first divergence has a top-1 minus top-2 logit gap of 0.375 or less. A split of the noise shows that cache entries written by multi-token passes are about as noisy as the multi-token pass itself. A margin gate (fall back to one token when the gap is below a bound calibrated on separate GSM8K prompts) whose fallback reads that cache does not help: 58 of 100 prompts differ, against 61 of 100 for plain verification. Rebuilding the cache with one-token passes leaves 0 of 100 different but costs 7.2 model passes per token, against 1.0 for the reference. Fixed-width decoding makes drafted and plain decoding identical (0 of 100 prompts differ) at 0.75 passes per token. On shifted MMLU and HellaSwag prompts the rebuild gate leaves 0 of 60 different, plain verification 48 of 60. On 138 further and shifted prompts the bound was exceeded at 0.6% of positions and missed 0 of 309 flips. One GPU, one drafter, small models.

analysis.key_results: 验证4个猜测token时60%的提示发生变化，padding改变68%；重建缓存后0%差异但每token需要7.2次模型前向；固定宽度解码以每token 0.75次前向实现0%差异。
analysis.limitations: 单个GPU、单个草稿模型、小模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 量化了投机验证与批处理/缓存等不同执行方式在有限精度下导致的贪心文本差异，并提出了重建缓存与固定宽度解码来消除噪声并评估其成本。
analysis.method: 对Qwen3-0.6B模型在不同解码方式（投机验证、批处理、缓存、padding）下进行有限精度舍入噪声测量，设计margin gate、重建缓存和固定宽度解码方法。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文测量并分析了投机解码中因有限精度舍入导致的贪心输出偏离，并评估了消除该噪声的方法及其计算成本。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注投机解码的数值噪声与消除，未直接涉及VLA或WAM；但其方法可用于任何自回归语言模型的高效推理，包括机器人策略或世界模型中的解码，对高效推理相关研究具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: We present Ego4Gen (Egocentric 4D Future Generation), a world model for 4D future generation in robotic manipu lation. Given a single egocentric image and a text prompt, Ego4Gen jointly generates temporally aligned RGB frames, dense point maps, and dense scene flow, explicitly pre dicting the evolution of scene appearance, spatial struc ture, and motion. Built on Cosmos3-Nano, Ego4Gen ex tends the pretrained generative backbone through modality routed LoRA and asymmetric attention, using geometric pseudo-labels from MotionCrafter to learn to predict future geometry and motion latents. These latents can either be decoded into explicit 3D structure and motion or mapped to robot actions. To this end, we also introduce FlowIn verse, a lightweight inverse dynamics network trained in two stages to translate predicted 4D latents into robot ac tions. Experiments show that these geometry and motion latents outperform the evaluated latent-action and video latent baselines in out-of-distribution settings. Closed loop policy evaluations further demonstrate their utility for translating predicted 4D futures into robot control. To gether, these results support geometry-grounded motion to kens as a world-action interface, connecting 4D future gen eration with robotic manipulation and suggesting a path to ward reduced reliance on action-labeled data.

analysis.key_results: 实验显示，几何与运动潜变量在分布外设置中优于潜在动作和视频潜变量基线；闭环策略评估证明了将预测的四维未来转化为机器人控制的实用性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Ego4Gen，一种能够联合生成未来 RGB、稠密点图和场景流的四维世界模型，并用几何驱动的运动标记作为世界-动作接口，实现从未来预测到机器人控制的连接。
analysis.method: 基于 Cosmos3-Nano 主干，通过模态路由 LoRA 和非对称注意力扩展；使用 MotionCrafter 生成几何伪标签；引入 FlowInverse 轻量逆动力学网络，两阶段训练将预测的四维潜变量映射为机器人动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Ego4Gen 是一个面向机器人操作的四维未来生成世界模型，可从单张第一人称图像和文本提示联合生成 RGB 帧、稠密点图和场景流，并通过预测的四维潜变量映射机器人动作。

papers.abstract: Autoregressive inference in large transformer models is limited by token-level sequential execution, resulting in high latency and low GPU utilization. Speculative decoding (SD) mitigates this bottleneck by introducing a draft-and-verifier model. However, the drafting stage remains sequential, leaving the verifier idle and underutilizing compute. To address this, we propose a plug-and-play drafting adaptive drafting method that parallelizes inference across transformer layers during draft generation. Starting from a shared hidden state, our approach evaluates multiple layers in parallel and verifies consistency by measuring divergence in hidden-state space. Layer-wise draft states are accepted when deviations are small; otherwise, a correction step is applied. By exploiting redundancy across transformer layers, our method accelerates draft generation and improves hardware utilization without modifying architectures or requiring retraining. Experimental results on NLP tasks show that our method speeds up the drafting stage by up to $1.65\times$ with minimal degradation in accuracy, while maintaining the same performance as SD.

analysis.key_results: 在NLP任务上，起草阶段加速最高达1.65倍，准确率下降最小，同时保持与投机解码相同的性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种即插即用的自适应并行起草方法，在草稿生成期间并行化Transformer层，无需修改架构或重新训练即可加速投机解码。
analysis.method: 从共享隐藏状态出发，并行评估多个Transformer层，并通过测量隐藏状态空间的偏差来验证一致性；当偏差较小时接受逐层草稿状态，否则执行校正步骤。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种即插即用的并行起草方法，通过在Transformer层间共享隐藏状态并并行评估多个层，减少起草阶段的顺序执行并提高硬件利用率，从而消除投机解码中验证器的空闲时间。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于通用推理效率，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人技术，但所提出的并行起草方法可直接应用于基于自回归Transformer的VLA或世界模型，以减少延迟并提高GPU利用率。

papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) capabilities have been associated with localized parameter regions, enabling targeted model editing and intervention. However, it remains unclear whether a region identified before model optimization remains an effective intervention target afterward. We evaluate the functional persistence and parameter overlap of coding capability regions across three instruction-tuned models under quantization, pruning, and LoRA-based adaptation. Although re-extracted regions exhibit substantial parameter reorganization, ablating the original region after optimization eliminates or nearly eliminates coding performance in almost all conditions, while magnitude-matched controls preserve performance. Partition analysis further shows that the shared subset of the original and re-extracted regions accounts for most of the observed ablation effect in the majority of conditions. These results demonstrate that parameter overlap and functional persistence are distinct: capability regions can remain causally effective intervention targets even when their parameter realization changes substantially.

analysis.key_results: 重新提取的区域存在显著参数重组，但消融原始区域在几乎所有条件下消除或几乎消除编码性能；共享子集在多数条件下贡献大部分消融效应。
analysis.main_contribution: 证明模型能力区域的功能持续性可以与参数重叠分离：即使参数表示发生显著重组，原始区域仍可作为因果有效的干预靶点。
analysis.method: 对三个指令微调模型进行量化、剪枝和LoRA适配，评估编码能力区域的功能持续性和参数重叠，并进行分区分析。

papers.abstract: Quantization enables efficient inference in language models through model parameter compression. This work audits the impact of quantization on capability and safety domains including model safeguards, instruction-following, ethics and bias. Through benchmarks, we find that model safeguards and bias can degrade under quantization, while other capabilities such as truthfulness remain more stable in Qwen3-4B. We define this uneven transfer of LLM capabilities under quantization as Jagged Robustness. We find multiple factors driving Jagged Robustness: task complexity, evaluation method and generation coherence. Moreover, we verify the degradation of model safeguards by observing increased compliance with unsafe requests under quantization, and demonstrate universal adversarial suffix attacks that are benign for the full model but jailbreak quantized models. The findings indicate that it is risky to assume that the performance and robustness can transfer evenly across different capability domains from full models to quantized models.

analysis.key_results: 模型安全防护和偏差在量化下退化，而真实性等能力在Qwen3-4B中较稳定；量化模型对不安全请求的合规性增加，且存在对全精度模型无害但能越狱量化模型的通用对抗后缀攻击。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出锯齿鲁棒性概念，揭示LLM量化对安全防护、偏差等能力的不均衡影响，并发现量化可导致新的越狱漏洞。
analysis.method: 通过基准测试审计量化前后模型在安全防护、指令遵循、伦理和偏差等领域的表现，并分析任务复杂度、评估方法和生成连贯性等因素。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文审计了量化对LLM能力与安全领域的影响，发现模型安全防护和偏差在量化下可能退化，并称之为锯齿鲁棒性。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language Navigation(VLN) requires an embodied agent to follow language instructions through unseen 3D environments, where the target spaces often lie beyond the current observation. Navigation world models address this challenge by predicting future views either as pixels or latent representations, providing valuable look-ahead information for action decision. Both paradigms define the future primarily through what the agent may observe, raising a fundamental question: is predicting future views the ultimate form to represent the future for VLN? Cognitive studies show that the human hippocampus prospectively represents both future goals and intervening locations along planned routes. Inspired by this predictive-map view, we organize the navigation-relevant future around goal-directed spatial states and route structure. We instantiate this perspective with two complementary abstractions: a short-horizon waypoint that specifies the next local state to reach, and a mid-horizon corridor that captures the spatial support of the upcoming route. Based on this design, we propose FS-Nav, a future-state world modeling framework that predicts waypoint-corridor states from spatial memory and language instructions, and communicates them to a VLM navigator through top-down and first-person interfaces. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks demonstrate that FS-Nav achieves state-of-the-art performance. This highlights navigation-relevant future-state modeling as a promising direction for representing the future in VLN.

analysis.key_results: 在标准VLN基准上实现了最先进性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FS-Nav，一种预测航点-走廊状态的未来状态世界建模框架，用于视觉语言导航。
analysis.method: 从空间记忆和语言指令预测短视距航点与中视距走廊状态，并通过俯视和第一人称接口传递给VLM导航器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FS-Nav提出一种未来状态世界模型，通过预测航点和走廊状态并与VLM导航器交互，在VLN中表达导航相关的未来。

papers.abstract: We present Zing-1.0, a Playable World System built on Controllable Rendering. An executable engine resolves player actions under the world's rules and produces proxy video from the updated state. A streaming video model synthesizes the player's view from this proxy, and the runtime delivers it to inform subsequent actions. (1) Principle and system. We formulate Controllable Rendering and define the interfaces among world construction, world execution, observation synthesis, and the interaction runtime. To our knowledge, this is the first implementation-independent specification of a Playable World System. (2) AI-native engine. WorldKit provides structured authoring tools and reusable character, camera, and control components for coding agents to construct executable proxy worlds. It supports extensible interactions and precise geometric motion control while separating executable behavior from final visual appearance. (3) Streaming renderer. We adapt MiniMax-H3 for block-causal autoregressive generation and incremental decoding. Proxy video constrains structure and motion, while text and separate scene and subject references specify appearance. We train the generator on diverse tasks and distill it to generate each block in a few denoising steps. The renderer leads the compared streaming editors on OpenVE (3.90) and LongV2VBench (3.44). On StreamEval, Zing-1.0 scores 57.86 on instruction editing and 54.06 on reference editing, exceeding the published baselines on both tracks. (4) Interaction infrastructure. We build an Interaction Runtime that routes player actions to WorldKit while supporting in-play prompt and reference updates. Cross-block joint execution and sparse attention with compressed K/V reduce inference overhead. With the DiT on a single H200 and encoding and decoding on one H100 each, the serving system achieves a steady-state throughput of 23.82 FPS at $832\times480$.

analysis.key_results: 在OpenVE上得分3.90，LongV2VBench上得分3.44，StreamEval指令编辑57.86分、参考编辑54.06分，均超过已发布基线；单H200 DiT加编码/解码各一个H100实现23.82 FPS的稳定吞吐。

papers.abstract: Latent action models let a robot policy learn from video by turning the change between two frames into a training target. In egocentric video, a cup can move across the image because a hand pushes it or because the wearer turns. Both changes help predict the next frame, but only the first describes manipulation. During training, EgoLAM supervises the action code with measured wrist motion and supplies camera motion separately to the forward model. Even when the wearer turns while pushing a cup, the training target still describes how the hand pushed it. The action encoder pools object slots around each hand, and wrist translation and rotation can be decoded from the code in a common reference frame. Extracting a code then requires only two RGB frames. Alongside LARYBench classification and regression, we measure how much wrist motion a frozen code retains and how strongly it responds to a synthetic view or lighting change. EgoLAM has the highest hand-motion decoding score among eight evaluated models. Across three LIBERO suites, policies pretrained on its codes and fine-tuned on expert demonstrations achieve 79.38% mean success, 28.73 points above expert behavior cloning and 9.76 points above the strongest other latent action model in each suite on average.

analysis.key_results: EgoLAM 在八个评估模型中具有最高的手部运动解码分数；在三个 LIBERO 套件上，基于其代码预训练并微调的策略平均成功率为 79.38%，比行为克隆高 28.73 个百分点，比最强其他潜在动作模型高 9.76 个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 EgoLAM，一种潜在动作模型，通过手腕运动监督和相机运动分离，从自我中心视频中学习操作相关的动作表示。
analysis.method: 使用手腕运动监督动作编码，将相机运动单独提供给前向模型；动作编码器融合每只手周围的对象槽，并在公共参考系中解码手腕平移和旋转。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: EgoLAM 提出一种潜在动作模型，通过手腕运动监督和相机运动分离，从自我中心视频中学习用于机器人操作的潜在动作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的动作表示学习，通过从视频中学习潜在动作以改善机器人操作策略，属于 VLA 和机器人学习范畴。

papers.abstract: Surface electromyography (sEMG) enables continuous hand-pose estimation, but learning representations that generalize across users and movements remains challenging. We introduce InterBand-EMG, which combines band-specific quantization with cross-band reconstruction and structured masked code prediction to learn transferable EMG representations for hand-pose tracking. We also introduce SynapMyo, an eight-channel EMG-to-pose dataset comprising 1,227.74 hand-hours from 499 users across 68 movement categories. Experiments on emg2pose and SynapMyo show that InterBand-EMG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in joint-angle accuracy across all three generalization settings on both datasets. The source code and the SynapMyo dataset will be publicly released upon acceptance of this paper.

analysis.key_results: 在emg2pose和SynapMyo数据集上，InterBand-EMG在三种泛化设置下均优于最先进的基线方法，关节角度精度更高。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出InterBand-EMG模型，结合频带特定量化、跨频带重建和结构化掩码码预测，学习可泛化的sEMG表征；并发布包含499名用户、1,227.74手小时的SynapMyo数据集。
analysis.method: 频带特定量化、跨频带重建、结构化掩码码预测。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出InterBand-EMG模型，通过频带特定量化、跨频带重建和结构化掩码码预测，学习可迁移的sEMG表征用于手部姿态估计，并发布了大规模SynapMyo数据集。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文关注sEMG的手部姿态估计，与机器人学习相关，但未涉及视觉-语言-动作模型或世界模型；其量化方法属于模型量化，但与VLA/WAM无直接结合。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates language generation by letting a target model verify several draft tokens in one forward pass. Earlier neural drafters such as EAGLE extend each candidate sequence one token at a time. Recent work has turned to parallel drafters such as DFlash, which predict a whole block at once. Another approach uses n-gram retrieval to find an earlier occurrence of the current context suffix and copy the tokens that followed it directly into the draft. We introduce CoPyro, which feeds these copied tokens into a parallel drafter in place of masks. The drafter learns from context which tokens to keep and which to revise as it predicts the block in its usual forward pass. Across eight benchmarks on Qwen3-4B, CoPyro improves overall acceptance length for all four parallel drafters tested, with gains of 2.19-5.08% when trained on 100K samples. With DFlash trained on 710K samples, overall gains range from 1.08% to 2.00% across the tested model sizes and temperatures. Code generation benefits most in both settings. On Qwen3-8B, processing the proposals adds an average of 0.24 ms per decoding round in Transformers.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3-4B上，四种并行起草器的整体接受长度提升2.19-5.08%（训练10万样本）；在DFlash训练71万样本时，不同模型规模和温度下提升1.08-2.00%；代码生成任务提升最大；在Qwen3-8B上，处理提议每轮解码平均增加0.24ms。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CoPyro框架，将n-gram检索的复制令牌作为并行起草器的输入以替代掩码，使起草器学会保留或修改这些令牌，从而提升整体接受长度。
analysis.method: 使用n-gram检索找到当前上下文后缀的先前出现位置，复制其后续令牌，并将其馈送至并行起草器（如DFlash）进行块预测。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CoPyro通过将n-gram检索的复制令牌与并行起草器结合，提升推测解码的接受长度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于推测解码这一高效推理技术，未直接涉及VLA或WAM。但其方法可用于加速任何自回归模型，包括机器人策略或世界模型，因此具有一定的潜在应用价值。

papers.abstract: Single-modality action-expert pretraining controls competition from visual shortcuts before vision--language--action (VLA) adaptation. Yet single-modality pretraining can impair the vision--language interactions needed for subsequent joint prediction. We construct a diagnostic model in which VA or LA pretraining can disable an initially active pathway for joint vision--language modeling. In this model, subsequent training with complete visual and language inputs cannot restore the pathway, even with unlimited adaptation. We therefore introduce Stochastic Context for Action Expert Pretraining (SCAP), a new action-expert pretraining stage that precedes full-input training. During this stage, visual and text tokens are randomly masked before entering the VLM. In this unified diagnostic model, SCAP can preserve the joint vision--language modeling pathway during pretraining and subsequent full-input training. Compared with direct full-input training, it can also reduce reliance on visual shortcuts and increase reliance on language instructions. SCAP consistently improves performance across four different VLA architectures. In real-robot experiments, it achieves 76.67% average success across three instruction-conditioned manipulation tasks, outperforming full-input pretraining by 25 percentage points.

analysis.key_results: SCAP在四种VLA架构上一致提升性能；真实机器人实验中，在三个指令条件的操作任务上平均成功率达76.67%，超过全输入预训练25个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SCAP预训练阶段，在动作专家预训练时随机掩码视觉和文本输入，以保持联合视觉-语言建模路径并减少视觉捷径依赖。
analysis.method: 在动作专家预训练阶段，对输入VLM的视觉和文本token进行随机掩码，形成随机上下文（Stochastic Context），随后再进行全输入训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出随机上下文动作专家预训练（SCAP），通过在预训练阶段随机掩码视觉和文本token，防止视觉捷径并保留视觉-语言联合建模能力，从而提升VLA模型性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接针对VLA模型训练策略，解决动作专家预训练中视觉捷径和模态交互受损问题，属于VLA策略学习与机器人操作的核心研究。

papers.abstract: Agent harnesses are turn-based: the agent acts, waits for the result, then reasons. When the action invokes a pretrained robot policy, such as a vision-language-action (VLA) or world action model (WAM), the policy may react continuously to observations, but the agent cannot revisit its decision until the call returns. Meanwhile, a person may step into the robot's path or move the object it is about to grasp. Invoking the agent more often narrows this blind interval, but a reasoning model takes seconds per decision and most control steps need no new one. We propose TRIP, a training-free, event-driven harness in which the agent programs its own interrupts. With each call, the agent writes a tripwire: a lightweight, stateful Python program that runs alongside the policy, can query a compact VLM (for example, to locate a person and measure their distance), and decides whether the call continues or control returns to the agent. When it fires, the harness halts the policy and returns control with the reason; the agent then reassesses, adapts, and continues under a rewritten tripwire. We evaluate TRIP with three VLAs and one WAM on RoboHD, a benchmark of 168 RoboCasa365 scenes in which a simulated person disturbs the robot and any human-robot contact counts as failure. Compared with a turn-based harness using the same agent and tools, TRIP halves the rate of human contact with the strongest policy, raising safety from 61.3% to 81.3%, without sacrificing task success (38.7% vs. 31.0%). Real-robot experiments show that TRIP completes two manipulation tasks under human interference where the turn-based harness and the policy alone largely fail.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboHD基准（168个RoboCasa365场景，模拟人类干扰）上，使用三种VLA和一种WAM评估，TRIP将人类接触率降低一半，最强策略的安全性从61.3%提升至81.3%，且任务成功率未受损（38.7% vs. 31.0%）；真实机器人实验表明TRIP在人类干扰下完成了两个操作任务，而基线方法大多失败。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TRIP，一种训练无关、事件驱动的智能体框架，允许智能体编写轻量级有状态Python程序（tripwire）来中断底层VLA/WAM策略的执行，从而在人类干扰等情况下及时重新决策。
analysis.method: 在每次调用VLA/WAM策略时，智能体生成一个tripwire（轻量级有状态Python程序），该程序与策略并行运行，可查询紧凑VLM以感知环境（如检测人员并测量距离），并在满足条件时中断策略，将控制权返回给智能体进行重新评估和调整。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种训练无关的事件驱动框架TRIP，使机器人智能体能够自行编程中断条件，在人类干扰下更安全、更高效地控制VLA/WAM策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对VLA/WAM在真实世界部署中的安全性和效率问题，通过事件驱动中断机制让上层智能体在必要时重新决策，属于VLA/WAM与高效推理（减少不必要的智能体调用）的结合，对机器人策略部署具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: JEPA-style world models support visual planning by predicting future representations conditioned on future actions. However, similar observations can conceal different motion states, making temporal context essential for interpreting future action effects. We propose PACE-WM, a parallel world model that uses executed-action history to contextualize future prediction and planning. Specifically, PACE-WM maintains a recurrent memory of executed actions and uses this memory to condition a causal Transformer. PACE-WM predicts multiple future representations in parallel without recursive predicted-state feedback within each prediction window. We further introduce Reference-Anchored Minimum Progress (RAMP) for action selection during planning. RAMP scores candidate actions by their predicted goal improvement along direct and split paths relative to a shared reference. Across four visual planning tasks, PACE-WM with RAMP achieves an average success rate of $98\%$ and plans approximately $7$-$9\times$ faster than autoregressive LeWM under matched CEM settings. We also construct four controlled benchmarks to evaluate PACE-WM's capabilities in motion disambiguation, goal-relative motion, and goal adaptation. Project page is available at https://github.com/LHS180/PACE-WM.

analysis.key_results: 在四个视觉规划任务中，PACE-WM with RAMP 平均成功率达 98%，在匹配的 CEM 设置下比自回归 LeWM 规划速度快约 7-9 倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 PACE-WM，一种并行世界模型，利用已执行动作的历史来有条件地预测未来表征，并引入 RAMP 动作选择方法，在视觉规划中实现更高成功率和更快规划。
analysis.method: 维护已执行动作的递归记忆，并用其条件化因果 Transformer；在不进行递归预测状态反馈的情况下并行预测多个未来表征；使用 RAMP 基于预测目标改进对候选动作评分。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 PACE-WM，一种利用动作历史进行时间上下文建模的并行世界模型，在视觉规划任务中显著提升成功率和推理速度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接属于世界模型（WAM）研究，聚焦于机器人视觉规划中的动作条件未来预测，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Visual labeling of egocentric demonstrations often leaves contiguous gaps in action supervision. Reliable poses around a gap still provide its net translation and rotation. We use this information to train vision-language-action policies while preserving ordinary flow matching on reliable local actions. A composition objective constrains the aggregate motion of missing-action estimates, combining multiple fixed windows when a gap exceeds the policy horizon. A shared interval branch learns from reliable endpoints and supplies the composition target. On LIBERO with 20% of demonstrations and 70.5% missing actions, the main method achieves 87.9% mean success over three training runs. In one paired comparison with matched observation exposure and training cost, its advantage over masking is 10.5%. On Ego-informed RoboTwin gaps, success is 45.4%, versus 40.3% for masking. On five real-robot tasks, mean success is 59.6%, versus 54.8% for interval flow matching alone and 48.8% for masking.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO上用20%示范且70.5%缺失动作时，主方法在三次训练运行中平均成功率达87.9%；在匹配观察暴露和训练成本的配对比较中，比掩码方法高10.5%；在Ego-informed RoboTwin gaps上成功率为45.4%，掩码方法为40.3%；在五个真实机器人任务上平均成功率为59.6%，而区间流匹配为54.8%，掩码方法为48.8%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出区间运动监督方法，在动作标注存在大量缺失的情况下，利用缺失段端点的净平移和旋转信息训练VLA策略，并通过组合目标约束缺失动作的聚合运动。
analysis.method: 在保留可靠局部动作上标准流匹配的同时，使用组合目标约束缺失动作估计的聚合运动；当缺失区间超过策略视界时，组合多个固定窗口；共享区间分支从可靠端点学习并提供组合目标。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出利用动作监督中的可靠端点信息，通过组合约束训练视觉-语言-动作策略，以应对示范数据中大量缺失动作标注的问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的训练，解决机器人动作标注不完整的问题，对VLA及机器人操作学习具有核心价值；与具体世界模型（WAM）无直接关联。

papers.abstract: Reward models and LLM judges are routinely quantized to 4 bits so that scoring many candidates stays affordable, and the usual check is that benchmark accuracy barely moves. That check is close to blind. Across eight reward models from two families (0.6B-8B), three generative judges and four 4-bit quantizers, quantization rewrites 1.1-12.3% of pairwise preference decisions on RewardBench while aggregate accuracy moves by as little as 0.03 points (p = 1.00), because the errors it fixes and introduces cancel. Flips concentrate where the full-precision margin is small relative to the quantization noise scale sigma: a Gaussian approximation Phi(-|m|/sigma) describes the aggregate rate, over-predicting it in all 30 scalar settings and failing for generative judges, and occupancy of the resulting vulnerability window falls from 25% to 7% with model size, which is what makes small judges fragile. The churn stays within noise under benign best-of-16 and becomes clear under adversarial pressure for some quantizers (146:54 harmful:helpful flips on one family, reversing sign on another). Downstream it changes what ships: across six (model, quantizer) pairs from two families, 14.6-65.7% of problems get a different best-of-64 selection while only 2.6-9.6% get a different final answer, with selections changing 5-8x more often than answers in every pair, and the pair the benchmark calls identical (0.03 points, p = 1.00) still changes 34.5% of them. Benchmark churn ranks that downstream change (rho = 0.89); benchmark accuracy does not order it reliably. Held-out audits then locate the useful diagnostic in the margin rather than the Gaussian: every margin-based predictor orders flips identically (AUC 0.927), and on the level a directly measured churn rate wins in-distribution. As a routing signal it is matched by plain top-k. The contribution is the characterization, not the model.

analysis.key_results: 量化重写了1.1-12.3%的成对偏好决策，基准准确率仅变化0.03分；脆弱窗口占比从25%降至7%随模型规模增大；14.6-65.7%的问题在best-of-64下选择不同，2.6-9.6%的最终答案不同；benchmark churn与下游变化相关性为0.89，margin预测器AUC为0.927。
analysis.limitations: 高斯近似在所有30个标量设定中均高估了翻转率，且对生成式裁判失效；提出的诊断方法在分布内与简单top-k相当；作者声明贡献在于特性刻画而非新模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 刻画了量化奖励模型中的决策不稳定性，提出了“脆弱窗口”概念，并表明基于margin的预测器比基准准确率更能预测下游决策变化。
analysis.method: 对八个奖励模型（0.6B-8B）、三个生成式裁判和四种4比特量化器进行实验，通过RewardBench上的成对偏好决策、best-of-16/64选择以及高斯近似和margin分析来量化决策翻转。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究了4比特量化对奖励模型和LLM裁判的偏好决策稳定性的影响，发现量化会在基准准确率几乎不变的情况下引发大量决策翻转。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系。本文专注于量化对奖励模型决策稳定性的影响，未涉及视觉-语言-动作模型或机器人世界模型，但其对量化引起的决策翻转的分析方法可能对高效部署VLA中的奖励模型或评估器有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Language-model agents using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) face three runtime verification gaps: (i) action fabrication, where post-tool prose narrates side effects that failed, timed out, or never ran; (ii) provenance collapse, where unverified model prose or web text enters durable memory alongside executed tool outputs; and (iii) syndicated echo amplification, where mirrored web pages satisfy multi-source corroboration from one origin. Existing MCP firewalls inspect wire calls before execution, while LLM-judge guardrails require multi-gigabyte VRAM without binding prose to receipts. We present epistemic-guard (v0.5.2), an open-source Python library and out-of-process stdio MCP receipt proxy (15 modules, 0 MiB GPU VRAM). epistemic-guard isolates Ed25519 signing keys out of process, writes RFC 6962 Merkle logs with AER-1 receipt translation, checks post-turn prose on CPU with SHA-256-verified OpenVINO INT8 encoders (4 models, 279.48 MB total; 82.67 MB on the supervision path), gates SQLite writes across 7 provenance domains, and collapses verbatim and lightly edited wire-syndicated RAG mirrors. On conformance suites, epistemic-guard rejects 100.0% of tampered receipts (200 Merkle leaves), passes 58/58 official AER-1 ingestion vectors and 50/50 reference-verified AER-1 exports, verifies 100.0% of 40 fault-injected wire calls and 100 concurrent appends with 0 key leaks, and blocks 100.0% of 100 unauthorized memory writes. Across $N=250$ frozen-benchmark traces, epistemic-guard reaches 93.2% accuracy at 17.9 ms warm median CPU latency (8.62 ms single-clause; 921.8 ms cold-start load), beating 12B-14B GPU judges by 6.4-6.8 points ($p=0.0259$, $p=0.0095$) at 4.26-4.5$\times$ lower latency; on $N=60$ live mcp-proxy traces, it catches 96.15% of hazards at 76.67% accuracy (38.24% FPR; $+18.34$ points over Stage-1-only, $p=0.001$) in 9.16 ms p50.

analysis.key_results: 在一致性测试套件中，epistemic-guard拒收了100.0%的篡改收据（200个Merkle叶子），通过了58/58个官方AER-1摄取向量和50/50个参考验证的AER-1导出，验证了100.0%的40个故障注入的线调用和100个并发追加且零密钥泄漏，并阻止了100.0%的100次未授权内存写入。在N=250个冻结基准追踪中，达到了93.2%的准确率，CPU延迟中位数为17.9毫秒（单子句8.62毫秒；冷启动加载921.8毫秒），比12B-14B的GPU评判器高出6.4-6.8个百分点（p=0.0259，p=0.0095），且延迟降低4.26-4.5倍；在N=60个实时mcp-proxy追踪中，以96.15%的召回率和76.67%的准确率（38.24%的假阳性率；比仅阶段1高18.34个百分点，p=0.001）在9.16毫秒的p50延迟下捕获了危险。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一个开源的Python库和进程外stdio MCP收据代理，用于解决语言模型代理在运行时验证中的三个缺口：行为捏造、来源坍缩和联合回声放大。
analysis.method: 采用Ed25519签名隔离、RFC 6962 Merkle日志、AER-1收据翻译、SHA-256验证的OpenVINO INT8编码器（4个模型，共279.48 MB；监督路径82.67 MB）、跨7个来源域的SQLite写入控制，以及缩减逐字和轻度编辑的联合RAG镜像。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出名为epistemic-guard的开源Python库和MCP收据代理，通过进程外签名、Merkle日志、CPU上的INT8编码器和来源控管内存写入，对使用工具的自主代理进行运行时验证。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文主要关注工具使用型语言模型代理的运行时验证，使用了量化技术（OpenVINO INT8编码器）来实现高效的CPU推理。它不直接涉及VLA、世界模型或机器人动作学习，但其量化方法和对代理安全验证的关注可能为机器人代理的可靠性提供方法学上的启发。

papers.abstract: Low-bit activation quantization of large language models remains challenging, as a small number of dominant directions dictate the quantization range. State-of-the-art methods isolate these directions in a high-precision subspace through transformations calibrated offline and folded into the weights, which fixes the subspace for all prompts, leaving each prompt's few unique directions unprotected, and rules it out wherever no weight can absorb the transformation. We present PLoQ, a prompt-adaptive low-rank decomposition that extracts the dominant activation components before quantization, quantizes them separately, and restores them within the layer's GEMM, without modifying the weights. The low-rank component's basis is estimated from each prompt during prefill and reused throughout decoding. At the same bit width as state-of-the-art mixed-precision quantization (4-bit weights, activations and K/V cache with an eighth of the channels at 8 bits, about 4.2 bits per activation on average), PLoQ outperforms it on all six Llama and Qwen models from 1B to 70B parameters, at up to 8k tokens (16k on two of them), recovering up to 46% of the perplexity that the state of the art still loses to 4-bit activations. On Llama-3.1-8B at 8k tokens it adds only 4% to prefill and 8% to decoding.

analysis.key_results: 在与最先进混合精度量化相同的比特宽度下（4位权重、激活和KV缓存，其中1/8通道为8位，平均每激活约4.2位），PLoQ在6个Llama和Qwen模型（1B到70B参数，最长8k token，其中两个达16k）上均优于该基线，最多恢复46%的4位激活量化引起的困惑度损失。在Llama-3.1-8B上，8k token时预填充仅增加4%，解码增加8%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PLoQ，一种提示自适应的低秩分解方法，在量化前提取激活值的主成分并单独量化，在层GEMM中恢复它们，而无需修改权重。
analysis.method: 在预填充阶段为每个提示估计低秩基，并在解码阶段复用；将主成分与量化后的残差分开处理，在GEMM中结合。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出PLoQ，在预填充阶段提取提示特定的激活值主成分作为低秩分量，并与量化后的残差一起进行GEMM计算，从而在4位量化中实现更低困惑度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文面向大语言模型的激活量化，没有讨论VLA、机器人世界模型或具身智能应用。其低秩分解和量化技术可能为VLA/WAM的高效推理提供启发，但摘要未直接涉及。

papers.abstract: Every move in a robot team changes the world in which its teammates must act. Coordinated manipulation therefore calls for predicting the team's actions together with the physical future they jointly create. We introduce MAWAM, a multi-agent world-action model that jointly generates each robot's future views and executable action chunks in a single sample. Built from a pretrained single-robot world-action backbone, MAWAM jointly denoises all robots' action and future-view tokens through cross-agent attention, while preserving a separate control interface for each robot. MAWAM achieves the highest success on all three real-robot tasks (laundry-bag collection, bath-towel folding, and umbrella handover), with 67.8% mean success, 18.9 percentage points above MA-VLA trained on the same demonstrations and cameras. In simulation, MAWAM reaches 90.3% mean success on eight tasks with teams of up to four arms. Ablations show that cross-agent attention and team-stage future-video supervision both improve coordinated control: without attention, a four-arm relay falls from 95.0% to 39.0%, and without this supervision, Place Food falls from 78.0% to 47.0%.

analysis.key_results: 在三个真实机器人任务上取得最高成功率，平均67.8%，比在相同演示和相机上训练的MA-VLA高出18.9个百分点；在八个仿真任务上平均成功率达90.3%，支持多达四臂团队。消融显示：无跨智能体注意力时四臂接力从95.0%降至39.0%；无团队阶段未来视频监督时，放置食物从78.0%降至47.0%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了MAWAM多智能体世界-动作模型，从预训练的单机器人世界-动作骨干构建，通过跨智能体注意力联合生成所有机器人的未来视图和可执行动作块，同时保持各机器人独立的控制接口。
analysis.method: 基于预训练的单机器人世界-动作骨干，通过跨智能体注意力联合去噪所有机器人的动作和未来视图token，并使用团队阶段未来视频监督。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: MAWAM是一个多智能体世界-动作模型，通过联合去噪生成每个机器人的未来视图和可执行动作块，实现协同操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接提出并验证了一个多智能体世界-动作模型（WAM），同时预测多个机器人的未来视图和动作，是WAM在多机器人协同操作场景下的扩展，与本站核心主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Reference-to-video diffusion transformers pack the variational autoencoder (VAE) latents of all references and the generated tokens into one full-attention sequence, in which reference tokens make up about half. Because attention cost grows quadratically with sequence length, these tokens take up an even larger share of the attention computation, yet most of them are static, smooth or irrelevant to the output. To accelerate reference-conditioned generation, we propose pruning and caching of reference tokens for video generation (PCRG), a training-free, plug-and-play method that uses two signals the model already computes to assign each reference token to one of three tiers, namely pruned, cached or kept. The first is a low-level redundancy r from VAE latents, since a token whose latent barely changes over time or across its neighbors adds little new content. The second is a high-level importance g from the vision-language-model (VLM) conditioner, where the attention that the prompt and any first or last frames pay to a token tells whether the output needs to read it. Tokens that are not redundant are kept, and redundant tokens are cached if important and pruned otherwise. Pruned tokens leave the sequence before the first step with all rotary position embedding positions unchanged. Cached tokens have their keys and values computed once and reused, and kept tokens are processed as usual. On MiniMax-H3, already distilled to 8 timesteps and quantized to int8, PCRG is 1.57x faster end to end on our V2V-Bench and 1.49x faster on the public VACE-Benchmark, while the quality of VBench drops by only 0.24% and 0.17%, respectively. PCRG shortens the sequence rather than changing how attention is computed or which steps are run, so it also stacks on step caching and sparse attention. On V2V-Bench it reaches 1.86x with TeaCache, 1.82x with Spark at nearly unchanged fidelity and 2.15x with Veda.

analysis.key_results: 在MiniMax-H3（8步蒸馏、int8量化）上，V2V-Bench端到端加速1.57倍、VACE-Benchmark加速1.49倍，VBench质量仅下降0.24%和0.17%；与TeaCache、Spark、Veda叠加分别达1.86x、1.82x、2.15x加速，质量几乎不变。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PCRG，一种训练免费、即插即用的参考token剪枝与缓存方法，用于加速视频扩散Transformer的参考条件生成。
analysis.method: 利用VAE潜在冗余度r与VLM条件重要性g两个已有信号，将参考token分为剪枝、缓存、保留三层；剪枝token在第一步前移出序列但保持rotary位置编码不变，缓存token只计算一次键值并复用，保留token照常处理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 针对参考条件视频生成提出训练免费、即插即用的参考token剪枝与缓存方法PCRG，通过冗余度和重要性两路信号将参考token分为剪掉、缓存或保留三层，在MiniMax-H3上取得约1.5倍端到端加速且质量损失极小。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于视频生成模型的高效推理，不直接涉及VLA或机器人世界模型。其token剪枝与缓存策略属于通用高效推理技术，可能对视频生成类世界模型或VLA中的视频编码模块有借鉴价值，但摘要未建立直接联系。

papers.abstract: A world model is trusted to answer "what if": how its world responds to an action it has never seen. We give a test of that trust for any action-conditioned world model: actions held out of training by design and scored against a known answer; whether forecast accuracy predicts accuracy on those actions; and the same structure given to simpler models. We run it in retail, where the action is a price and promotion plan, across 2,853 fitted models. First, forecast accuracy is a fair guide between kinds of model (rank correlation with error on new plans 0.32 to 0.66) and a poor guide between versions of one world model: where merchants plan into high-demand weeks the link reverses, down to -0.69. Second, training the world model to learn the effect of actions (JEPA pretraining, a latent consistency check, adaptation at the plan date) leaves its error on new plans unchanged. Third, in generated worlds the recorded regular price and three price rules improve it. Given the same rules, a log-linear model is best when its curve can match the truth; in a world whose curve lies outside the rules, the world model with the rules is ahead of the log-linear model with the rules in 36 of 40 worlds, and does as well without its recurrent cell. On real data (Breakfast at the Frat, The Complete Journey and M5) the rules lower the world model's error on pure price cuts deeper than any it saw (0.63 to 0.56 on the Frat; 0.45 to 0.44, within chance, on The Complete Journey), but not on lasting price moves. Fourth, a small share of random test plans helps every model a little. In a generated dosing world, a stress test in a second domain, the first finding repeats, and the built-up drug level lowers the world model's error (2.86 to 1.91) though it still predicts only 0.12 to 0.32 of the true gain. The test carries to any domain where a world model is asked about actions outside its history.

analysis.key_results: 预测准确率在不同模型种类间是公平指导（秩相关系数0.32到0.66），但在同一世界模型的不同版本间（如高需求周规划时）相关性可反转为-0.69；JEPA预训练、潜在一致性检查和计划日期适应未改变新计划的误差；价格规则在生成世界和真实数据上均降低误差；一小部分随机测试计划对所有模型有轻微帮助；在生成给药世界中，累积药物水平将误差从2.86降至1.91。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种针对动作条件世界模型在未见动作上可信度的测试框架，并系统评估了预测准确率作为泛化误差指导的有效性、JEPA预训练等改进方法的效果，以及价格规则和随机保留计划的影响。
analysis.method: 设计保留动作的评估方法，包括根据已知答案对动作进行留出、检验预测准确率与泛化误差的相关性，并在2,853个拟合模型上对比不同模型结构、JEPA预训练、潜在一致性检查、计划日期适应、价格规则和随机测试计划等策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文为动作条件世界模型提出一种针对训练中未见动作的评估方法，并在零售数据上验证预测准确率与泛化误差之间的关系及多种模型改进策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究聚焦于通用动作条件世界模型的评估与改进，虽然具体实验在零售领域，但其方法可迁移至机器人世界模型（WAM）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，用于评估模型在未见动作上的泛化能力，对本站主题具有方法论参考价值。

papers.title: Testing World Models on Actions They Have Never Seen: Held-Out Plans, Forecast Accuracy and Price Rules in Retail

papers.abstract: Robot-use agents (RUAs) have emerged as a promising approach to general-purpose robot control. However, strong performance has so far been achieved only by frontier proprietary models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.2, whereas open-weight models remain substantially less capable. We show that an open-weight 27B reasoning model can be trained to use real robots natively through reinforcement learning, entirely in simulation and without demonstrations. Like a computer-use agent (CUA), the model observes the environment, reasons in a chain of thought, and generates the next end-effector pose, without any harness. We build a Post-training Engine for Agentic Robotics (PEAR) and use it to train the model on simulated robot tasks at scale with robot-use reinforcement learning (RURL), mirroring how frontier models acquire computer use. We find that the skills acquired in simulation generalize well beyond the training tasks: they transfer to an unseen robot, to the real world, and to novel instructions. After training on LIBERO and RoboDojo in simulation, the model succeeds in 60% of our trials on a real dual-arm robot, whereas the base model succeeds in none. On LIBERO, training raises the success rate from 1.6% to 74.4%, approaching GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol at maximum reasoning effort. Compared with $\pi_{0.5}$, a vision-language-action model fine-tuned on demonstrations, our model is substantially more robust to changes in the task itself. On LIBERO-Pro, $\pi_{0.5}$ succeeds in only 0.75% of episodes when assigned a new task in a familiar scene whereas our model succeeds in 57.4%. Finally, the model retains its general capabilities, with no measurable degradation on nine reasoning, coding and vision benchmarks. These results highlight robot-use reinforcement learning as a promising component of foundation-model post-training.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO和RoboDojo仿真训练后，真实双臂机器人试验成功率达60%，而基座模型为0；在LIBERO上成功率从1.6%提升至74.4%；在LIBERO-Pro上对新任务的成功率达57.4%，优于π0.5的0.75%；在九个基准上无性能退化。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一种后训练引擎（PEAR），用于在仿真中通过机器人使用强化学习（RURL）训练开源推理模型，使其原生地控制真实机器人，且无需示范。
analysis.method: 在仿真中构建大规模机器人任务，使用强化学习训练开源推理模型，模型观察环境、链式思考并生成末端执行器位姿。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种机器人使用智能体（RUA）方法，通过仿真中的强化学习训练开源推理模型原生控制真实机器人，无需示范。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接研究VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型的强化学习后训练，通过仿真训练推理模型原生地控制机器人，对VLA研究具有核心价值。

papers.abstract: World-action models adapt pretrained video generators, and vision-language-action models build on vision-language backbones, tying policy architecture and inference cost to large transformers designed for generation rather than control. While recent world-action models mostly scale the video backbone and its data, we argue that the choice of latent space is just as critical, and that the policy should be trained natively in that space. We introduce Latent Action JEPA (La-JEPA), a compact world-action model whose policy transformer is trained from scratch in the feature space of a pretrained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder; it predicts future features with actions during training and generates only actions at inference. Among policies without embodied pretraining, La-JEPA achieves state-of-the-art average RoboTwin 2.0 success under both clean-only and full training, and state-of-the-art LIBERO-Plus success with corrected instructions, while using far fewer parameters than the strongest competitors; with full training, its success scales with model size up to 2.1B. Its S and B policies run two to five times faster than Fast-WAM and Faster-WAM while outperforming both on LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0, and La-JEPA outperforms the closest JEPA-based methods, LeapBot-WA and JEPA-WAM, without their pretrained policy backbones. On four real-robot tasks, its average success is comparable to $\pi_{0.5}$. A design study shows that JEPA features outperform video VAE latents, most clearly out of distribution, and that training-time future prediction improves the policy even when skipped at inference. Tailoring the policy's design, including its latent space, to control can thus matter more than the knowledge transferred from a pretrained generative backbone, suggesting that robot foundation models may benefit from architectures designed for control rather than inherited from generation.

papers.abstract: Autoregressive driving world models systematically suffer from structural drift, identity drift, and quality decay over long rollout horizons due to transient conditioning signals that lack persistent state. We present WAM-Sim, a driving world model anchored by a persistent hierarchical memory and optimized via online flow-matching RL. WAM-Sim structures persistent context across three temporal and semantic scales: pose-aligned structural tokens encoding persistent road topology, read-only scene tokens supplying geolocated background appearance, and write-once instance tokens preserving individual traffic participant identities across occlusions and chunk boundaries. To restore visual sharpness and physical plausibility degraded by multi-scale conditioning, we introduce an online post-training framework that optimizes self-generated rollouts via flow-matching RL guided by hierarchy-aligned visual rewards and a vision-language model physical judge. The invariant memory empirically confines policy optimization within the anchored context, helping suppress semantic collapse and reward hacking, while online RL systematically enforces physical commonsense and fine-grained visual fidelity. On the nuScenes benchmark, WAM-Sim achieves a superior generation fidelity (FID=3.47, FVD=25.72) and strong downstream perception performance (24.16 mAP, 71.23 road mIoU). On minute-scale rollouts of self-collected data, WAM-Sim substantially mitigates structural and identity drift, preserving high scene similarity and subject identity coherence across extended horizons. Project page: https://fudan-generative-vision.github.io/WAM-Sim.

analysis.method: 构建三类持久记忆（姿态对齐结构token、只读场景token、一次性写入实例token）；引入基于层级对齐视觉奖励和视觉语言模型物理评判器的在线流匹配RL优化。

papers.abstract: Embodied world models should not only imagine plausible futures, but also perceive the geometric, semantic, and motion structure of the evolving world. We present GenSight, a unified embodied world model that brings future video generation and dense perception into a single pretrained video diffusion transformer. GenSight uses a unified spatiotemporal representation for video, depth, embodiment segmentation, and first-frame-relative 2D flow. Built on a shared DiT backbone, GenSight uses lightweight task modulation to predict all modalities within the same architecture. All tasks are jointly optimized within a unified velocity prediction space. At inference, GenSight supports two complementary modes: multi-step future video generation with aligned dense predictions and single-step dense perception from an observed video. By unifying modality representation, model architecture, and prediction space, GenSight avoids separate modality-specific pipelines and couples appearance, geometry, semantics, and motion in a shared representation. It promotes cross-modal consistency and allows dense perception to benefit from the spatiotemporal priors learned through video generation. Trained on embodied manipulation data spanning multiple robot embodiments and human-hand interactions, GenSight demonstrates strong performance in both video generation and dense 4D perception, highlighting the effectiveness of unifying seeing and imagining for embodied world modeling.

papers.abstract: Conditional memory layers, such as DeepSeek's Engram, attach large hashed n-gram tables to a language model, and removing them from DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash costs 36.8 PopQA points. Low-bit quantization loses long-tail facts first, and the standard remedy, giving more bits to frequently accessed rows, backfires: refining lookups by access frequency is worse than refining them at random. We trace this to the gate that scales each retrieved row. A lookup's quantization error is weighted by its gate, which is small for frequent n-grams, large for the rare n-grams of long-tail entities, and computable from a 1-bit code. GateRQ therefore stores each row as a ladder of 1-bit residual codes, keeps level 1 in GPU memory to compute the gate, and reads deeper levels only for the lookups the gate ranks highest. Without retraining, GateRQ cuts GPU table memory by 7.8x on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, which raises vLLM throughput by 11%-31% over FP8 tables, while losing about 1 PopQA point at 1.50 bits read per lookup and 0.2 points at 2.10 bits across two models.

analysis.key_results: 在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上，GPU表内存减少7.8倍，vLLM吞吐较FP8提升11%-31%，在两个模型上1.50位/查找时PopQA损失约1点，2.10位时损失0.2点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GateRQ方法，通过1位残差编码和门控决定读取深度，在不重训练的情况下将GPU表内存压缩7.8倍，并提升vLLM吞吐。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 针对LLM条件内存层，提出基于门控的按查找精度分配量化方法GateRQ，以减少GPU内存并提升吞吐。

papers.abstract: We introduce RynnUnify, a 16B unified embodied model that combines strong embodied understanding with long-horizon visual planning through interleaved video--language reasoning. With capabilities spanning spatial reasoning, physical prediction, and grounding, RynnUnify connects an understanding of the physical world with visual anticipation of how it evolves across successive subtasks. Building on these capabilities, we further develop an agentic extension through reinforcement learning to selectively use video predictions for reasoning about unobserved states and interaction outcomes. We also develop a world-action extension of the full RynnUnify model, translating its understanding and prediction capabilities into robot control. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Rynn-VP and Rynn-GEU for long-horizon visual planning and anticipatory reasoning. Experiments show that RynnUnify achieves the highest average embodied understanding score among the evaluated unified multimodal models and improves the Rynn-VP overall score by 9.75 points over Cosmos 3 Nano. Its agentic extension improves the Rynn-GEU average by 6.0 points over direct reasoning, while the world-action extension achieves 51.5\% success on 20 selected composite RoboCasa365 tasks and 46.7\% average success across three real-robot tasks. Together, these results establish RynnUnify as a shared foundation for embodied understanding, visual planning, and robot control, taking a step toward a unified embodied brain.

papers.abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) aims to recover reasoning capabilities in low-bit large language models (LLMs). Existing recipes typically supervise the quantized student with the original full-precision model on fixed response sequences. However, the resulting low-bit quantized models still struggle on long-horizon reasoning tasks and often fail to terminate within a token budget that suffices for the full-precision model. We identify two challenges in closing this gap. First, fixed-response supervision leaves a mismatch between training prefixes and those encountered during student generation, and this trajectory divergence grows as responses lengthen. Second, on its own prefixes, the student underpredicts some next-token candidates and overpredicts others, and this distributional misalignment becomes more frequent at high-entropy prefixes. We present OnQ, a low-bit recovery pipeline that combines on-policy distillation and candidate-wise Dynamic KL. Starting from block-wise calibration, the quantized student generates responses and receives full-precision teacher supervision on its own prefixes. Dynamic KL weights forward and reverse KL by each candidate's teacher-student probability ratio to balance correction of under- and overprediction. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B at 2- and 3-bit precision, OnQ achieves the highest nine-benchmark average, with the largest gains on long-horizon reasoning benchmarks. At 2 bits, it outperforms every baseline on every benchmark at every model size, improving the Qwen3-8B average by 10.26 points over the strongest baseline. It also produces shorter responses with fewer truncations and repetitive errors.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3-1.7B、4B和8B的2/3比特模型上，OnQ在九个基准平均分上取得最高，并在2比特下在所有基准和模型规模上优于所有基线，其中Qwen3-8B平均分比最强基线提高10.26分。

papers.abstract: Learning loco-manipulation policies requires demonstrations that capture coordinated base and arm motion on the target embodiment. Robot-free interfaces allow demonstrations to be collected independently of the target robot, increasing flexibility but without directly capturing platform-specific commands, proprioception, and body-mounted observations. On-robot teleoperation allows to capture these signals directly, but requires an interface capable of commanding the complete system concurrently. This paper presents LocoPilot, a single-operator bilateral teleoperation and data-collection framework implemented on a 12-DoF Unitree Go2 quadruped equipped with a 6-DoF AgileX Piper L manipulator, an Intel RealSense D435 wrist camera, and an Intel RealSense D405 head camera. A second 6-DoF Piper L arm, used as the leader and two handheld controllers provide simultaneous control of the base, body posture, manipulator, and gripper. The follower arm interaction forces are estimated without a dedicated force/torque sensor and rendered to the operator through a passivity-constrained haptic channel. A ROS~2 pipeline records synchronized multimodal observations together with a unified 11D action shared by teleoperation and policy deployment. Compared to prior work, LocoPilot uniquely unifies robot-in-the-loop legged data collection, force feedback without motion-capture instrumentation, and the same action interface at deployment. We evaluate the interface across multiple loco-manipulation tasks and validate the complete collection-to-deployment pipeline by fine-tuning MolmoAct2 on pick-and-place demonstrations and deploying on the physical robot without action retargeting or additional inverse kinematics. Code available at: https://github.com/iit-DLSLab/LocoPilot

papers.abstract: Multimodal LLMs can fail to read text embedded in an image's coarse structure, text a human recovers by squinting, and report that no text is present. We name this class Squint Text and study it as a recognition deficiency, motivated by cases from a production moderation pipeline. We introduce SquintBench, comprising 1076 production-derived moderation images, and SquintCtrl, a controlled synthetic suite for mechanism diagnosis. Frozen-weight analysis shows that hidden text leaves a coarse signal while glyph identity is weakly decodable under global pooling. Restricting read-out to the text region improves glyph-identity decoding, identifying spatial selection as an important factor in glyph-identity read-out; an exact glyph mask further improves decoding. Suppressing high-frequency content also improves reading at a fixed visual-token budget, while visual token count may also contribute. These findings motivate Squint OPSD: a frozen teacher receives a downscaled view and the ground-truth transcription as privileged context, and its token-level distributions supervise a student along on-policy trajectories. At inference, the student reads the original image alone. Squint OPSD reaches 88.61 ANLS on SquintBench, versus 26.50 for the unadapted backbone, 24.44 for the best general-purpose model on the original view, and 68.60 at best for an off-the-shelf model under a downscaled view. These results substantially narrow the gap between available visual evidence and its generated read-out without auxiliary views at inference.

analysis.key_results: Squint OPSD在SquintBench上达到88.61 ANLS，未适配骨干为26.50，最佳通用模型为24.44，低分辨率视图最佳现成模型为68.60。
analysis.main_contribution: 定义“眯眼文本”（Squint Text）现象，构建SquintBench和SquintCtrl数据集，并提出Squint OPSD方法通过蒸馏提升识别性能。
analysis.method: 构建真实与合成数据集；冻结权重分析诊断解码瓶颈；Squint OPSD利用预训练教师模型在低分辨率视图和文本真值辅助下，以在线策略蒸馏训练学生模型。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models struggle to reuse recurring atomic actions across manipulation tasks. Our diagnostic study reveals that reliable task completion does not imply consistent execution of constituent atomic actions across task contexts. We present LexiconVLA, a retrievable atomic-action lexicon for cross-task reuse. Global and detail codebooks capture shared interaction structure and fine-grained execution variation respectively, preserving both reusable patterns and execution details. Visual-Atomic Action Alignment couples trajectory reconstruction from visual state changes with visual outcome prediction from action codes, grounding the lexicon in motion and its effects. We learn these codebooks with trajectory reconstruction and visual alignment on our AtomAction Dataset of 57,803 segments from 69 tasks. A planner and scene-aware adapter translate new goals into code-conditioned subtasks for a shared policy, without skill-specific experts or deployment-time parameter updates. Across five policy backbones on 26 RLBench tasks, LexiconVLA largely maintains performance on 18 seen tasks while improving success on 8 tasks held out from policy training. With BridgeVLA, unseen-task success rises from 16.67% to 34.17% (+17.50 percentage points), and overall success reaches 71.08%, the highest among methods with reported results. Real-robot experiments demonstrate stepwise execution and failure recovery.

analysis.key_results: 在26个RLBench任务上，18个已见任务性能基本保持，8个策略训练中未见任务成功率提升；BridgeVLA上未见任务成功率从16.67%提升至34.17%（+17.50个百分点），总成功率达71.08%，为已报告结果中最高。

papers.abstract: Low-precision Transformer systems increasingly quantize attention matrix multiplications, while softmax often remains at higher precision. During pretraining, an approximate softmax changes the gradients that train the model as well as its forward computation. We study this interaction with K-interval attention, which approximates the exponential using K+1 grid values. We vary per-row grid calibration, interpolation versus hard rounding, and the placement of a straight-through surrogate relative to normalization. We derive the corresponding backward rules, including calibration derivatives, and compare these choices in pretraining experiments matched on model, data, and optimizer. Detaching the row extrema leaves the forward computation unchanged but produces a delayed increase in validation loss, under both min-max and fixed-window calibration. With hard rounding at K=4, min-max calibration and a pre-normalization surrogate incur a large loss gap; changing either choice substantially reduces it. At 124M parameters and 2.5B training tokens, fixed-window calibration with interpolation ends +0.007 nats from softmax at K=4; with hard rounding it ends +0.019 nats at K=4 under a post-normalization surrogate and +0.004 nats at K=16 under a pre-normalization surrogate.

analysis.key_results: 在124M参数、2.5B训练token设置下，固定窗口校准与插值在K=4时比softmax高0.007 nats；硬舍入在K=4时高0.019 nats（后归一化代理）或K=16时高0.004 nats（前归一化代理）。
analysis.main_contribution: 推导了K区间量化softmax的反向传播规则，包括校准导数，并通过预训练实验系统比较了逐行网格校准、插值与硬舍入、直通代理位置等选择的影响。
analysis.method: K区间注意力，使用K+1个网格值近似指数函数；比较逐行校准、插值/硬舍入、归一化前后放置直通代理，并推导对应反向规则。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究在注意力中使用K区间量化softmax进行Transformer预训练，比较不同校准、插值与直通估计器选择对训练效果的影响。

papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) use video generation models to predict future visual dynamics for robotic manipulation, but iterative denoising introduces additional latency for closed-loop control. We empirically find that visual content converges at different rates during denoising. Static background structure forms early, whereas the gripper and manipulated object remain blurry after the first step, with their interaction dynamics emerging only through subsequent denoising. Consequently, naively truncating a multi-step video model to one step preserves scene structure but loses the interaction-centric dynamics most critical for manipulation. To address this issue, we propose DIDO, which distills the converged dynamics of a multi-step video model into a single denoising step. DIDO combines distribution matching distillation with interaction-centric representation guidance. Beyond compressing multi-step generation into one forward pass, DIDO explicitly models the gripper, manipulated object, and their interaction using supervised bounding-box visual reasoning tokens. Additionally, DIDO aligns the target object's representations across multiple model layers with features from a pretrained DINOv3 encoder. This interaction-centric guidance helps the distilled model preserve both the relevant entities and their future dynamics in a single step, while substantially reducing inference latency. DIDO achieves an average success rate of 99.0\% on LIBERO, 76.6\% on LIBERO-Plus, and 92.0\% on RoboTwin, while also demonstrating effective transfer to long-horizon and generalization tasks in real-world robotic manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO上平均成功率为99.0%，LIBERO-Plus上为76.6%，RoboTwin上为92.0%，并展示了在真实世界长时程和泛化任务中的有效迁移。

analysis.method: 结合分布匹配蒸馏与交互中心表示引导，利用有监督的边界框视觉推理token显式建模夹爪、被操作物体及其交互，并将目标物体表示与预训练DINOv3编码器特征对齐。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: DIDO将多步视频世界动作模型的收敛动力学蒸馏为单步去噪，并引入交互中心表示引导，在保持抓取与物体交互动态的同时大幅降低推理延迟。

papers.abstract: Large-scale recommendation systems face "Memory Wall" bottlenecks due to massive, dense embedding tables. While generative retrieval uses discrete tokens for IDs, high-dimensional context still relies on inefficient dense formats. Inspired by computer vision data compression, we propose Dual-purpose Semantic IDs to achieve LLM-level I/O efficiency. Our methodology uses hierarchical quantization to condense continuous embeddings into discrete Semantic IDs performing two concurrent roles: (1) Collaborative Identity: modeling user-item interactions via learnable embedding table; and (2) Content Reconstruction: using a lightweight Semantic Decoder for on-the-fly embedding approximation. This approach replaces massive vector storage with on-demand reconstruction, reducing system overhead and data footprints. We demonstrate the efficacy of our framework through offline evaluations and successful online deployment in production-scale ranking and retrieval systems at a major video sharing platform, showing that discrete tokens are indeed all you need for highly efficient, content-rich recommendation.

papers.abstract: Mixed-precision quantization assigns each module of a language model its own precision format, such as NVFP4, FP8, or BF16, to minimize damage within a memory budget. Most allocators predict the damage of a configuration by summing per-unit sensitivities measured in unquantized networks. But the sensitivity of a unit \textit{saturates} as more units are quantized, so the sum overprices the heavily quantized configurations that tight budgets require. Assuming only that damage accumulates by an associative, increasing, continuous rule restricts it to the form $g\bigl(\sum_i b_i\bigr)$, with summed sensitivities as the case of linear $g$. We propose SaturQ, which uses a concave $g$, fits the per-unit parameters $b_i$ from a single Aumann--Shapley path integral, and allocates formats with a linear program. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, SaturQ lowers KL divergence to BF16 by 11--23\% relative to ModelOpt AutoQuantize at 4.2--6.0 effective bits, and it outperforms an interaction-aware allocator that measures up to 2{,}410 configurations while measuring only three. It also predicts the damage of unmeasured configurations with a median error of 6.9--11.4\%, lower than Gaussian-process and random-forest surrogates fit to 300 configurations, and served allocations of Qwen3.6-27B and GLM-5.2 (753B) run faster than vendor NVFP4 checkpoints at comparable accuracy.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，SaturQ在4.2–6.0有效比特下将KL散度比BF16降低11–23%（相对ModelOpt AutoQuantize）；仅用三次测量优于测量2410个配置的交互感知分配器；对未测量配置的KL散度预测中位误差为6.9–11.4%，低于300个配置训练的高斯过程与随机森林代理模型；Qwen3.6-27B和GLM-5.2（753B）的分配比供应商NVFP4检查点更快且精度相当。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SaturQ，一种饱和感知的混合精度量化分配器，使用凹函数聚合单元敏感度，并通过线性规划分配精度格式，在多个大型语言模型上优于现有方法。
analysis.method: 假设损伤按结合、递增、连续规则累积，将其限制为g(Σb_i)形式，采用凹函数g，通过单次Aumann-Shapley路径积分拟合参数b_i，并用线性规划分配格式。
