papers.abstract: 3D vision-language-action (VLA) models process both image and point cloud tokens at each control step, increasing the cost of action prediction. Token pruning can reduce this cost, but a token's contribution depends on which other tokens remain. We present 2Dor3D, a framework that jointly selects which 2D and 3D tokens to retain under a fixed token budget. Our analysis shows that either modality can compensate for the other within a patch, that neighboring correlations help explain differences in pruning risk, and that shared tokens couple pruning decisions across patches. In one box-closing observation, two patches with nearly identical interaction scores differed eightfold in the action deviation caused by removing their image token. Guided by these findings, 2Dor3D transfers cross-modal prediction residuals to retained tokens, uses neighborhood correlation entropy to explore more retention choices at local outliers, and updates pruning costs after each proposed exchange between coupled regions. A fused GPU kernel packs the selected tokens into a shorter sequence for subsequent Transformer layers. Across RLBench and LIBERO, 2Dor3D speeds up end-to-end inference by $2.06$--$2.10\times$ on MLA and $1.86$--$1.91\times$ on FiS-VLA, with task success rates 0.5--0.6 percentage points below the corresponding unpruned models.

analysis.key_results: 在 RLBench 和 LIBERO 上，2Dor3D 使 MLA 端到端推理加速 2.06–2.10 倍，FiS-VLA 加速 1.86–1.91 倍；任务成功率比未剪枝模型低 0.5–0.6 个百分点。

papers.abstract: Policy gradient computes a backward pass for every sample, although the backward pass is expensive and most samples carry little learning value. The Delightful Policy Gradient (DG) scores learning value in the forward pass with \emph{delight}, the product of advantage and surprisal (negative log-probability). We introduce the \emph{Kondo gate}, which compares delight against a compute price and pays for a backward pass only when the sample is worth it; sweeping the price traces a quality--cost trade-off. On MNIST, keeping 3\% of gradient terms learns faster than standard policy gradient even when backward passes are free, and nearly matches full DG. In bandits, zero-price gating preserves the expected gradient direction and removes its perpendicular noise, delight ranks samples more reliably than additive mixes of value and surprise, and a rare action with high reward variance marks where delight fails. On transformer token reversal, the gate's advantage grows with sequence length and vocabulary size. Because delight tolerates moderate noise, a cheap approximate forward pass could screen samples before expensive backpropagation, a training analogue of speculative decoding.

analysis.key_results: 在MNIST上仅保留3%梯度项即可比标准策略梯度更快学习，并接近完整愉悦梯度；在赌博机问题中零价格门控保持期望梯度方向并移除垂直噪声；在Transformer词元反转任务中，门控优势随序列长度和词表大小增长。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入愉悦策略梯度，利用优势函数与惊异度的乘积（愉悦）在前向传播中筛选有价值的样本，并设计Kondo门根据计算价格控制反向传播的触发。
analysis.method: 通过计算愉悦分数（优势×惊异）并与可调计算价格比较，决定是否为样本执行反向传播，从而实现稀疏反向传播和训练加速。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种名为愉悦策略梯度的方法，通过前向计算的愉悦度分数筛选高学习价值样本，仅对值得的样本执行反向传播，并用Kondo门实现质量-成本权衡。

papers.abstract: This article suggests a reasoning-guided vision-language-motion diffusion framework (RG-VLMD) for generating instruction-aware co-speech gestures for humanoid robots in educational scenarios. The system integrates multi-modal affective estimation, pedagogical reasoning, and teaching-act-conditioned motion synthesis to enable adaptive and semantically consistent robot behavior. A gated mixture-of-experts model predicts Valence/Arousal from input text, visual, and acoustic features, which then mapped to discrete teaching-act categories through an affect-driven policy.These signals condition a diffusion-based motion generator using clip-level intent and frame-level instructional schedules via additive latent restriction with auxiliary action-group supervision. Compared to a baseline diffusion model, our proposed method produces more structured and distinctive motion patterns, as verified by motion statics and pairwise distance analysis. Generated motion sequences remain physically plausible and can be retargeted to a NAO robot for real-time execution. The results reveal that reasoning-guided instructional conditioning improves gesture controllability and pedagogical expressiveness in educational human-robot interaction.

analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种推理引导的视觉-语言-运动扩散框架，整合多模态情感估计、教学推理和教学行为条件运动合成，实现教育人机交互中自适应且语义一致的机器人手势生成。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出推理引导的视觉-语言-运动扩散框架（RG-VLMD），用于教育场景中人形机器人的指令感知共情手势生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向机器人动作生成，使用视觉-语言输入和推理策略驱动扩散模型，可视为一种面向人形机器人的条件动作生成方法，与VLA（视觉-语言-动作）核心思想紧密相关；虽未显式涉及世界模型，但分段意图和教学计划的条件化机制可视为对动作生成上下文的显式建模，对机器人动作策略学习具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: World models have been developed to support sample-efficient deep reinforcement learning agents. However, it remains challenging for world models to accurately replicate environments that are high-dimensional, non-stationary, and composed of multiple objects with rich interactions since most world models learn holistic representations of all environmental components. By contrast, humans perceive the environment by decomposing it into discrete objects, facilitating efficient decision-making. Motivated by this insight, we propose \emph{Slot Transformer Imagination with CAusality-aware reinforcement learning} (STICA), a unified framework in which object-centric Transformers serve as the world model and causality-aware policy and value networks. STICA represents each observation as a set of object-centric tokens, together with tokens for the agent action and the resulting reward, enabling the world model to predict token-level dynamics and interactions. The policy and value networks then estimate token-level cause--effect relations and use them in the attention layers, yielding causality-guided decision-making. Experiments on object-rich benchmarks demonstrate that STICA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art agents in both sample efficiency and final performance.

analysis.method: 将观察表示为对象中心token，加上动作和奖励token，世界模型预测token级动态；策略和价值网络估计token级因果关系并利用注意力层进行因果引导决策。
